paragraphs: Menaḥem, Hillel's colleague, Mishnah Ḥagigah 3:2 [source locator]. He left for royal service with eighty men dressed in gold; Shammai entered in his place as head of the court, Ḥagigah 16. Sefer ben Guryon says he was a great sage like a prophet, and foretold to Herod when young that he would reign for more than thirty years. He reigned thirty-seven years and gave him great wealth.
